metadata.name: claude-desktop
metadata.description: Anthropic Claude Desktop application with AI assistance capabilities

latest.installScript: TMP=$(mktemp -t claude-desktop).dmg && curl -fL -o "$TMP" 'https://claude.ai/download/mac' && MNT=$(hdiutil attach "$TMP" -nobrowse -plist | sed -n 's:.*<string>\(/Volumes/[^<]*\).*:\1:p' | tail -1) && APP=$(find "$MNT" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.app' | head -1) && sudo rm -rf '/Applications/Claude.app' && sudo cp -R "$APP" /Applications/ && hdiutil detach -quiet "$MNT" && rm "$TMP"

aiPrompts.versionDiscovery: Check official Claude download page at https://claude.ai/download/ for latest versions. Verify installers are available for Windows (EXE), macOS (DMG), and Linux (AppImage).
aiPrompts.urlResolution: Platform-specific URLs: Windows: https://claude.ai/download/win, macOS: https://claude.ai/download/mac, Linux: https://claude.ai/download/linux
aiPrompts.updateGuidance: Monitor Claude Desktop releases through official Anthropic channels. Claude Desktop is automatically updated through the application. Verify compatibility with system requirements.
